sources.title: How to Install & Run GPT-OSS 20b and 120b GGUF Locally?
sources.snippet: GPT-OSS is a two-model, open-weight lineup built for real work: 120B for high-reasoning, production use that fits on a single H100, and 20B for fast local runs, fine-tuning, and lower-latency apps. Both ship under Apache-2.0, support function calling/structured outputs, and use the Harmony chat format for consistent responses.
